summary: Gate progression reference: L1-L8 activation sequences for 7 workflow types (new feature, bug fix, security patch, breaking change, dep upgrade, refactor, docs update) with per-layer required/optional module lists and workflow-specific constraints. Module activation matrix: tabular R/O/- view by workflow type, by L4 gateway signal, by platform, plus Provenance cascade conditions, Nexus refresh conditions, and minimum receipt set per workflow type.
